# LexonIT

> LexonIT is an AI & web development agency based in Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. It builds AI chatbots, Next.js/React web applications, business automation, and IT consulting solutions for startups and SMEs, and also develops its own in-house software products.

## What LexonIT Offers

- AI chatbots and conversational agents (WhatsApp integration, natural language processing, booking automation)
- Next.js / React web development (server-side rendering, high-performance websites)
- Business automation (CRM sync, automated invoicing, lead nurturing, workflow automation)
- Custom AI models fine-tuned on business data
- IT consulting for IT service providers, including AI project management and scheduling tools
- eCommerce solutions and mobile applications (iOS & Android, React Native)

## In-House Products

- **Sakhi Safety** — a personal safety app for iOS and Android with instant SOS alerts, live location sharing, trusted emergency contacts, and a safety check timer.
- **AutoHirU** — an AI-powered job search tool that auto-applies to jobs on a user's behalf across LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other job platforms, with AI resume matching and application tracking.

## Client Work

- **JKS Learning** — a career-ready IT upskilling platform offering structured Full Stack (Java, .NET, Frontend), Cloud, and SAP training, with anti-skip video protection and adaptive AI mock interviews.
- **TechieMaya** — a technology consulting company delivering Project-Management-as-a-Service (PMaaS) and IT solutions that help growing businesses automate routine tasks.
- **Mr LAD** — an AI Sales Employee platform that prospects, holds conversations, and books meetings autonomously across LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, email, and voice.
- **Dycnity** — an IT consulting and digital transformation firm helping organizations modernize with enterprise-grade technology solutions.
- **Infiniti Solars** — South India's leading residential and commercial rooftop solar installer, based in Nellore District, Andhra Pradesh.
